vulnerabilities.description: Jenkins instance exposes unauthenticated /prometheus endpoint disclosing workspace details.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Configure Prometheus metrics access token or bind behind authenticated reverse proxy.

vulnerabilities.title: Deprecated TLSv1.0 Protocol Enabled
vulnerabilities.description: Web service negotiates legacy TLSv1.0 protocol susceptible to BEAST cipher attacks.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 in web server SSL configuration.

findings.title: Exposed Database Listener on External Lab Interface
findings.description: PostgreSQL database service port 5432 is publicly exposed on the lab host interface without IP firewalling, potentially inviting unauthorized brute force or protocol probes.
findings.remediationAdvice: Bind PostgreSQL to localhost (127.0.0.1) or restrict access via iptables/UFW to authorized application nodes only.

findings.title: Jenkins Prometheus Metric Endpoint Unauthenticated Disclosure
findings.description: Continuous Integration server exposes system performance metrics, internal project names, build executor IDs, and filesystem paths without requiring authentication.
findings.remediationAdvice: Enable endpoint authentication in Jenkins security settings or restrict port 8080 access using a reverse proxy with basic authentication.

findings.title: Deprecated TLSv1.0 Cryptographic Protocol Enabled
findings.description: The remote service encrypts traffic using the deprecated TLSv1.0 protocol which lacks modern cryptographic cipher suites.
findings.remediationAdvice: Update nginx configuration ssl_protocols directive to include only TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3.

findings.title: Missing DMARC Email Anti-Spoofing Policy
findings.description: Domain publishes an SPF record but lacks a valid _dmarc TXT record. Lack of DMARC enforcement allows threat actors to forge emails spoofing the lab domain.
findings.remediationAdvice: Publish a TXT record at _dmarc.lab.example with policy p=quarantine or p=reject and specify a rua mailto report address.

findings.title: Internal Whitepaper Leaking Pipeline Paths in Search Index

findings.remediationAdvice: Remove internal whitepaper from public directory and configure robots.txt Disallow rule for /docs/internal/ folder.

findings.title: Nginx Default Server Banner Discloses Precise Version

findings.remediationAdvice: Set server_tokens off; in nginx.conf to suppress banner version leaks.

findings.title: Jenkins CI Remote Unauthenticated Metrics Exposure
findings.description: The Jenkins instance exposes /prometheus metrics endpoint without authentication, revealing internal job names and workspace paths.
findings.remediationAdvice: Restrict network access to port 8080 or enable authentication on internal metric scrapers.
